title: BIASBUSTERS: UNCOVERING AND MITIGATING TOOL SELECTION BIAS IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Creating a benchmark of functionally equivalent API clusters, prompting LLMs to select an API to answer user queries, and calculating the total variation distance between the model's empirical API selection rates and an ideal uniform distribution.
Cyclically rotating the order of tools presented in the prompt and computing the total variation distance between the model's selection rates for absolute prompt positions and a uniform distribution.
